A Letter For You

FROM ONE BESTIE TO ANOTHER

Akshara, we met on 6 October 2026, and from that day it felt like I had known you forever. We think alike, we like the same things, and we just understand each other — that is a rare thing. You are so special to me, and I promise to always be a good support for you — the one who stands with you in your happiness and in your sadness. Thank you for being with me. It is a real pleasure to have a friend like you. 💖
